Home / Contact

Get in touch

Questions about 3D printed miniature scale conversion? If you found a wrong percentage, want a new gaming scale added to the calculator, or have an idea for a new 3D print tool, pick a template below. I reply when I can — usually within a couple of days.

Send me a message

Use the Google Form below. No account needed. I read every submission and reply within a couple of days.

Open form

Pick a topic

Report a wrong percentage

Source scale, target scale, and what you think the correct value is.

Request a new scale

Scale name, games that use it, and how it is measured.

Suggest a feature

What it does and why it would help. I read every idea.

Request early access

For the STL File Manager. Tell me what you would use it for.

Response time

Usually a couple of days

Scale corrections get priority. I print a test piece to check before updating the site. Feature requests take longer because I need to think them through.

GitHub

For bugs and code

Found a bug in the converter? Open an issue. I do not check social media.

Open an issue

Who replies

kitsorix

I am the person who built the converter, wrote the reference library, and printed the test pieces. There is no support team.
